name: DK Fast Expand
replayNeeds: UD DK opener with early expansion (~6:00 timing) — any pro game showing clear expo decision. Happy, 120, or Labyrinth preferred.

name: Crypt Lord Fast Fiend Push
replayNeeds: UD Crypt Lord first hero into fast Fiends — aggressive timing push. Look for CL openers in UDvHU games.

name: DK Ghoul Rush
replayNeeds: UD DK with mass Ghouls vs Night Elf — aggressive early game. Sometimes called 'ghoul pull' build. Any UDvNE game where ghouls are the primary army.

name: FS Fast Tech
replayNeeds: Orc Far Seer skipping Barracks, rushing Stronghold — fast tech build. FoCuS is known for this style. Any OvH game with no T1 combat units.

name: MK Fast Expand
replayNeeds: Human Mountain King first hero into fast expansion — look for MK opener with early second Town Hall. Cash, TH000, or Infi preferred.

name: Paladin Rifle
replayNeeds: Human Paladin first hero with mass Riflemen — Holy Light sustain build. Any pro game with Paladin first in HvO or HvN.

name: DH Fast Bear Tech
replayNeeds: NE Demon Hunter opener into fast T3 Druid of the Claw (bears). The standard NE build — any pro NE game with DH first and bear transition. Moon, Foggy, Lawliet preferred.

name: PotM Mass Huntress
replayNeeds: NE Priestess of the Moon first hero with mass Huntresses — Trueshot Aura build. Any EvH game with PotM opener.

name: DH Mass Talons
replayNeeds: NE Demon Hunter into mass Druids of the Talon with Cyclone spam — the classic anti-Orc melee build. Any EvO game heavy on Talons/Cyclone.

name: DH Mass Huntress
replayNeeds: NE Demon Hunter opener with fast Huntress production and map control. Any pro NE game with DH + Huntress focus.
